units.source_text: 叶子立在那儿，像邮差似的伸手递了过去，然后慌忙跪坐下来。

en.t: Yoko stood there, reached out and handed it over like a postman, then hurriedly knelt down.

units.source_text: 当岛村打开这张折叠的纸条时，叶子已经渺无踪影了。

en.t: By the time Shimamura opened the folded note, Yoko had already disappeared without a trace.

units.source_text: 岛村连一句话也没说上。

en.t: Shimamura did not even have a chance to say a word.
